the metabolomics approach is a powerful and effective way to identify the genetic loci influencing the metabolites, and the association mapping is a useful tool for the discovery of the genetic loci of metabolites in rice germplasmas.
this study provides the first comprehensive profiling of rice metabolites and a valuable resource for further studies on the genetic basis of rice metabolites.

the metabolic profiling and association mapping of the 41 rice metabolites in the present study could provide valuable information for understanding the metabolic diversity of the Chinese core collection, as well as for the development of new rice varieties with improved nutritional value.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

metabolomics is a powerful method to reveal the variations in metabolites among rice accessions and association mapping is a powerful tool to identify the chromo- somal loci controlling metabolite concentrations.

the metabolic profiles were significantly different in the Chinese core collection of rice germplasm, and the identified markers can be used as molecular markers in breeding programs to improve the concentrations of metabolites.
metabolic profiling and association mapping could be used as effective approaches to identify the genetic loci influencing metabolites, and to explore the genetic diversity of rice germplasmas.
